newsitem.title: GREECE: Delta Informatics says 96 profit up 29pct.
newsitem.headline: Delta Informatics says 96 profit up 29pct.

text.p: Greek information technology firm Delta Informatics officials told institutional investors that 1996 pretax profits rose 29.08 percent to 1.327 billion drachmas from 1.028 billion in 1995.
The company's turnover rose 64.3 percent in 1996, to 3.52 billion drachmas from 2.142 billion a year earlier.
Its main shareholder with more than a 70 percent stake is Alpha Credit Bank.

Among Delta's activities is the processing of election results and credit cards. The processing of credit cards of 13 banks is its core business, accounting for more than 50 percent of its turnover, officials said.
The company will pay a fiscal 1996 dividend of 540 million drachmas against 450 million in 1995 -- a dividend per share of 120 drachmas.
